entries.name: base plate
entries.description: Flat bottom plate that supports the whole part and carries mounting points

entries.name: flange
entries.description: Flat disc or projecting rim used to join or mount one part to another

entries.name: hub
entries.description: Central thick cylinder around which other features are arranged

entries.name: bore
entries.description: Cylindrical hole through the centre, often to seat a shaft

entries.name: boss
entries.description: Raised cylindrical pad around a hole to add local thickness

entries.name: shaft
entries.description: Long rotating cylinder that transmits torque

entries.name: keyway
entries.description: Rectangular slot cut along a shaft or hub to lock a gear or coupling

entries.name: key
entries.description: Small metal block fitted into a keyway to prevent relative rotation

entries.name: spline
entries.description: Series of parallel ridges on a shaft that mesh with matching grooves

entries.name: rib
entries.description: Thin reinforcing wall that stiffens a plate or wall

entries.name: gusset
entries.description: Triangular plate that braces two members at an angle

entries.name: web
entries.description: Central thin plate connecting flanges of a beam or section

entries.name: mounting hole
entries.description: Hole used to bolt the part to a surface

entries.name: bolt hole
entries.description: Hole arranged on a bolt circle for fastening, e.g. in a flange

entries.name: slot
entries.description: Elongated opening allowing adjustment during assembly

entries.name: counterbore
entries.description: Stepped cylindrical enlargement at a hole mouth to sink a bolt head

entries.name: countersink
entries.description: Conical bevel at a hole entrance allowing flat-head screw to sit flush

entries.name: chamfer
entries.description: Angled cut at an edge or hole mouth, removing the sharp corner

entries.name: fillet
entries.description: Rounded internal or external blend that reduces stress concentration

entries.name: collar
entries.description: Ring around a shaft used for positioning or spacing

entries.name: spigot
entries.description: Short projecting cylinder that locates into a matching recess

entries.name: thread
entries.description: Helical ridge for screws; external on bolts, internal in tapped holes

entries.name: gear teeth
entries.description: Evenly spaced projecting teeth on a gear rim that mesh with another gear

entries.name: bracket
entries.description: Angled support that holds one part onto another

entries.name: arm
entries.description: Projected member reaching out from the body to carry a load

entries.name: spring coil
entries.description: Helical coil of wire that stores and releases elastic energy

entries.name: nozzle
entries.description: Tapered outlet that directs flow of fluid

entries.name: spout
entries.description: Open pouring tube extending from a vessel

entries.name: o-ring groove
entries.description: Recessed annular groove on a shaft or face designed to hold an elastomeric seal ring

entries.name: step / shoulder
entries.description: Transition between two cylindrical diameters on a turned shaft

entries.name: pocket
entries.description: Recessed cavity milled into a solid face with defined depth and boundary walls

entries.name: connecting arm
entries.description: Structural arm or shank bridging two or more boss eyelets in a mechanical linkage or lever

entries.name: dog-leg / neck bend
entries.description: Axial step offset or cranked bend in a connecting arm between non-coplanar boss faces

entries.name: eyelet / boss
entries.description: Cylindrical head or lug with a central bore for pin, shaft, or bearing attachment

entries.name: taper bore
entries.description: Conical tapered hole designed for locking hub, taper gauge, or ball joint seating
